encoder_adjacency_probe.method: identical synthetic [1,128,150] features through the substituted and the teacher encoder; the graph takes features, not raw audio, so no fixture is needed
encoder_adjacency_probe.reading: the two encoders are essentially uncorrelated on the same input. This does NOT prove the substitution is wrong. Per-tensor correlation is 0.798 and a 1.58-bit quantization compounded over 24 Conformer layers is enough to destroy output correlation. It also does not prove the substitution is right.
encoder_adjacency_probe.consequence: encoder-output adjacency is not a usable gate for this candidate. The only meaningful gate is the transcript oracle against a redux reference decode, which needs NeMo and is still open.
encoder_adjacency_probe.note: the probe is cheap and worth rerunning once the pos_bias gap closes, but it should not gate the work either way
